entities.name: NR Sidelink Capable UE
entities.description: A UE capable of NR sidelink communication and SLSS/PSBCH transmission that meets conditions for NR sidelink communication operation.

entities.name: In Coverage Condition
entities.description: UE is in coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication as defined in TS 38.304 and has selected GNSS or cell as synchronization reference.

entities.name: Out of Coverage Condition
entities.description: UE is out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication, frequency is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList or sl-FreqInfoList, and has selected GNSS or cell as synchronization reference.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED Network Controlled Condition
entities.description: UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state and networkControlledSyncTx is configured and set to on.

entities.name: syncTxThreshIC Condition
entities.description: networkControlledSyncTx is not configured, syncTxThreshIC is configured, and RSRP measurement of reference cell is below syncTxThreshIC value.

entities.name: syncTxThreshOoC Condition
entities.description: syncTxThreshOoC is included in SidelinkPreconfigNR, UE is not directly synchronized to GNSS, and UE has no selected SyncRef UE or PSBCH-RSRP measurement is below syncTxThreshOoC.

entities.name: GNSS Selected Condition
entities.description: UE selects GNSS as the synchronization reference source.

entities.name: Sidelink SSB Transmission
entities.description: Procedure for transmitting sidelink SSB on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication, including transmission of SLSS and MasterInformationBlockSidelink.

entities.name: SLSS
entities.description: Sidelink Synchronization Signal transmitted as part of sidelink SSB.

entities.name: MasterInformationBlockSidelink
entities.description: Master Information Block for Sidelink transmitted as part of sidelink SSB.

relations.description: NR sidelink capable UE initiates sidelink SSB transmission when specified conditions are met.
In coverage condition guards initiation of sidelink SSB transmission.
Out of coverage condition guards initiation of sidelink SSB transmission.
RRC_CONNECTED network controlled condition guards initiation of sidelink SSB transmission.
syncTxThreshIC condition guards initiation of sidelink SSB transmission.
syncTxThreshOoC condition guards initiation of sidelink SSB transmission.
GNSS selected condition guards initiation of sidelink SSB transmission.
Sidelink SSB transmission procedure includes transmission of SLSS.
Sidelink SSB transmission procedure includes transmission of MasterInformationBlockSidelink.
